videos.title: Open House
videos.description: Buying a house can be a stressful, time-consuming process, which is why people turn to shows such as "Open House" to get help in the real estate market. Hosts Sara Gore and George Oliphant (who also rescues homeowners' renovation projects on sister show "George to the Rescue," which began as a segment of "Open House" before becoming a stand-alone show) showcase some of the hottest homes on the market in major cities, get interior design tips from experts and provide information on what people need to know about stylish living.

videos.description: Dr. Rae and Peter care for injured wildlife in Costa Rica and join conservationists in building a bridge to give endangered howler monkeys a safe path through the rainforest; later, Peter helps treat an electrocuted monkey at a wildlife hospital.

videos.description: From Yellowstone to the Sonoran Desert, Dylan Dreyer meets North American wonders, including bald eagles and grizzly bears gone fishing, a fox family face-off and adorable baby lambs.

videos.title: The Great American Journey
videos.description: Kelsey Grammer explores the ways Americans come together, from the National Mall and Golden Gate Bridge to American car culture and jazz music.

videos.title: Wild Child
videos.description: From huge humpback calves and giant newborn giraffes, to colossal capybara pups and enormous emu hatchlings, Sheinelle Jones uncovers some of the coolest -- and biggest -- babies ever seen.
